subject: Request: Confidential VPC POC credits & regional restrictions
messages:
From: Alex Porter <aporter@veridianhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: maya.chen@veridianhealth.com, procurement@veridianhealth.com
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request: secure VPC POC + trial credits?

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Redwood throughput looked promising for our telehealth summarization flow. Security is the gating factor for us: we need an isolated VPC deployment (no shared tenancy), support for HSM/KMS key control, audit log export, and a short SOC2 evidence package to present to our InfoSec reviewers.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood sponsor additional free credits for a 6-week on‑prem/VPC POC so we can validate both performance and operational controls?
- If yes, we also need the trial limited to our eu-west-1 region and a written MOU covering data handling and retention.

I've attached a one‑pager (POC requirements) — procurement may need a formal statement of work and an MOU. Pricing/contract can follow once security signs off.

Appreciate any quick guidance here — our InfoSec review is scheduled for Sep 8.

Best,
Alex
Alex Porter
Head of Platform Engineering, Veridian Health
aporter@veridianhealth.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: POC-SOW-Veridian-v1.docx (docx), Data-Requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alex Porter <aporter@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request: secure VPC POC + trial credits?

Hi Alex — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful.

Short answers up front: yes, we can provide a sponsored credit package and an MOU covering data handling; we can also scope the pilot to eu-west-1. A couple of clarifying points before I confirm numbers with legal/procurement: 

1) Target workload: you mentioned telehealth summarization — can you share expected peak TPM (tokens per minute) and average sequence length? That helps size the dedicated pool.
2) The POC duration you requested is 6 weeks; would you be open to a 4‑week initial tranche with a pre-agreed top-up if security needs more time? This is usually faster to approve.
3) We will need to confirm whether any patient PHI will be processed in the pilot (we can support either but the compliance bar changes).

Looping in Lauren (contracts) and Sean (solutions) to bias the approval and prepare the SOC2 snapshot + MOU draft. Sean — can you prepare a short checklist of the evidence artifacts we can provide within 48 hours? Lauren — if we approve credits, what's our standard sponsored-credit cap for an isolated VPC pilot?

I'll hold on committing numbers until we get answers above.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — happy to own the evidence checklist. Alex, copied Lauren to keep procurement in the loop. Quick note on deliverables we can provide immediately: 

- SOC2 snapshot (control mapping + last audit date) — attached as a redacted PDF.
- Architecture diagram for Private (VPC) deployment with KMS/HSM integration.
- Exportable audit logs (S3 or transfer) and suggested retention policies.
- Ops runbook for incident response during the pilot.

If you can confirm TPM and PHI status we can size the cluster and propose a credit amount. For isolated VPC pilots we typically approve an initial cap (USD) tied to a 4‑week window; if more time is needed we do a time‑boxed top-up agreement in writing.

Sean Gallagher
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks Sean, Karthik — TPM estimate: 22k tokens/minute peak (burst), average 3k TPM. Average sequence length ~600 tokens. We will not route PHI into the pilot; only de-identified summaries and synthetic traces for validation.

Procurement asks whether Redwood can ramp to eu-west-1 only and if credits can be quarantined to our VPC with a usage cap and automated cutoff if anomalous exports appear. Also would like MOU language about retention (30 days logs, then archive) and audit access scopes.

I'll review the SOC2 snapshot and follow up with a procurement contact for SOW redlines.

— Alex

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request: secure VPC POC + trial credits?

Karthik / Sean — I reviewed the ask and SOC2 snapshot. Given Veridian's non-PHI stance for the pilot, I can approve an initial sponsored credit allocation of $25,000 for a 4‑week VPC pilot limited to eu-west-1. Conditions:

- Credits are tied to the deal RDW-VER-2027-09 and only usable by the Veridian project tags.
- Usage cap and automatic cutoff to be enforced by the infra policy we will apply to the VPC (we will set the cutoff at $28,000 to allow safe buffer, then notify both teams at 80% usage).
- Veridian must sign the MOU addendum covering data handling, retention, and audit/cooperative access. I attached a draft MOU/Privacy addendum for review.

If both sides agree, legal should route the DocuSign and I can authorize the credit release once procurement countersigns. Sean — please prepare the infra config and confirm the automated cutoff implementation timeline.

— Lauren
Contracts Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MOU-privacy-addendum.docx (docx)

Lauren — will do. Infrastructure notes: we will provision a dedicated VPC in eu-west-1 with dedicated compute pool, enforced project tags, and a usage watcher that triggers a soft alert at 80% and hard cutoff at the configured threshold. Timeline to spin up the environment and hand off to Veridian is 3 business days after the signed MOU.

Alex — procurement: once you sign the MOU and return the countersigned SOW, I will schedule the kick‑off and provide the keys/connection details. Expect a short readiness checklist (access to a test dataset, service account, and a small ingestion key).

Thanks — will update hubspot and fire off DocuSign link.

— Sean
